title: Word Search II
prompt:
Implement `Solution.findWords(board, words)`. Return every distinct word that can be traced in the character grid. Consecutive letters in one word must use horizontally or vertically adjacent cells, and a cell may be used at most once in that word.

Constraints make one DFS per word too slow: `board` can be up to 12 by 12, `words` can contain up to 30,000 lowercase words, and each word can have length up to 10. Build a trie for all candidate words, walk the board with DFS, and prune exhausted trie branches when useful. The returned collection must contain no duplicates; its order is not part of the contract. Restore the board before returning.

example.reasoning: The first four words each have an edge-adjacent path; stone does not.
